import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, dendrogram
from scipy.spatial.distance import squareform
h={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
aa="A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V".split()
raw="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
idx={c:i for i,c in enumerate(aa)}
Bm=np.array([[int(v) for v in ln.split()] for ln in raw.strip().split("\n")],dtype=np.float64)
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,0) for c in s])
G=10.0
def nw(a,b):
    ea,eb=enc(a),enc(b); n,m=len(a),len(b); S=Bm[np.ix_(ea,eb)]
    H=np.empty((n+1,m+1)); H[0]=-G*np.arange(m+1); H[:,0]=-G*np.arange(n+1); j=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        t=np.empty(m+1); t[0]=H[i-1,0]-G
        t[1:]=np.maximum(H[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1],H[i-1,1:]-G)
        H[i]=np.maximum.accumulate(t+G*j)-G*j
    i,k=n,m; ident=0
    while i>0 and k>0:
        if abs(H[i,k]-(H[i-1,k-1]+S[i-1,k-1]))<1e-9: ident+=(a[i-1]==b[k-1]); i-=1; k-=1
        elif abs(H[i,k]-(H[i-1,k]-G))<1e-9: i-=1
        else: k-=1
    return 100.0*ident/min(len(a),len(b))
F="accession,protein_name,organism_name,ec,sequence,reviewed"
def seqs(q,size=60):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={"query":q,"fields":F,"format":"tsv","size":size},headers=h,timeout=120)
    L=r.text.strip().split("\n"); hd=L[0].split("\t")
    return [dict(zip(hd,x.split("\t"))) for x in L[1:] if len(x.split("\t"))==len(hd)]
panel=[]
for q,lab,sz in [("ec:3.5.3.24","APAUH (EC 3.5.3.24)",60),
                 ("(ec:3.5.3.11) AND (reviewed:true)","agmatinase (EC 3.5.3.11, reviewed)",60),
                 ("(ec:3.5.3.1) AND (reviewed:true)","arginase (EC 3.5.3.1, reviewed)",10),
                 ("accession:A0A855A6N2","C. leptum CH238_05280 (query)",1)]:
    for d in seqs(q,sz): panel.append((d,lab))
seen=set(); rows=[]
for d,lab in panel:
    a=d["Entry"]; s=d["Sequence"]
    if a in seen or not (200<len(s)<420): continue
    seen.add(a)
    rows.append({"acc":a,"group":lab,"rev":d.get("Reviewed",""),
                 "org":d["Organism"].split("(")[0].strip()[:30],"seq":s})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).reset_index(drop=True)
print("panel:",len(df)); print(df.groupby(["group","rev"]).size().to_string())
Q=df.seq[df.acc=="A0A855A6N2"].iloc[0]
df["pct_id_to_query"]=[nw(Q,s) for s in df.seq]
out=df.drop(columns="seq").sort_values("pct_id_to_query",ascending=False)
print("\nIdentity to C. leptum CH238_05280 (A0A855A6N2), nearest 12 of %d:"%(len(df)-1))
print(out.iloc[1:13][["acc","group","rev","org","pct_id_to_query"]].to_string(index=False))
print()
for g in sorted(df.group.unique()):
    v=df.pct_id_to_query[(df.group==g)&(df.acc!="A0A855A6N2")]
    if len(v): print(f"  {g:36s} n={len(v):2d}  max {v.max():5.1f}  mean {v.mean():5.1f}  min {v.min():5.1f}")
A=df.pct_id_to_query[df.group.str.startswith("APAUH")].max()
B=df.pct_id_to_query[df.group.str.startswith("agmatinase")].max()
print(f"\nbest APAUH {A:.1f}%  vs  best agmatinase {B:.1f}%  -> margin {abs(A-B):.1f} points")
tt=out[out.acc=="Q5SJ85"]
if len(tt): print(f"T. thermophilus Q5SJ85, the one APAUH with measured activity (PMID 15983049): {tt.pct_id_to_query.iloc[0]:.1f}%")
# full matrix on a subsample for the tree
sub=pd.concat([df[df.acc=="A0A855A6N2"],
               df[df.group.str.startswith("APAUH")].head(12),
               df[df.group.str.startswith("agmatinase")].head(14),
               df[df.group.str.startswith("arginase")].head(6)]).drop_duplicates("acc").reset_index(drop=True)
if "Q5SJ85" not in set(sub.acc) and "Q5SJ85" in set(df.acc):
    sub=pd.concat([sub,df[df.acc=="Q5SJ85"]]).reset_index(drop=True)
n=len(sub); D=np.zeros((n,n))
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1,n): D[i,j]=D[j,i]=nw(sub.seq[i],sub.seq[j])
print(f"\ntree built on a {n}-sequence subsample")
Z=linkage(squareform(100-D,checks=False),method="average")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,7))
dendrogram(Z,labels=[f"{r.acc} {r.org}" for r in sub.itertuples()],orientation="right",ax=ax[0],
           color_threshold=0.5*Z[:,2].max())
cols={"APAUH (EC 3.5.3.24)":"#c0392b","agmatinase (EC 3.5.3.11, reviewed)":"#2f5d9e",
      "arginase (EC 3.5.3.1, reviewed)":"#7f8c8d","C. leptum CH238_05280 (query)":"#009e73"}
for t in ax[0].get_ymajorticklabels():
    acc=t.get_text().split()[0]; g=sub.group[sub.acc==acc].iloc[0]
    t.set_color(cols[g]); t.set_fontsize(7)
    if acc in ("A0A855A6N2","Q5SJ85"): t.set_fontweight("bold"); t.set_fontsize(9)
ax[0].set_xlabel("average-linkage distance (100 minus % identity, global NW with BLOSUM62)")
ax[0].set_title("Arginase-fold panel. Red: annotated aminopropylagmatine ureohydrolase.\nBlue: reviewed agmatinase. Grey: arginase. Green bold: C. leptum CH238_05280.",fontsize=9)
order=["APAUH (EC 3.5.3.24)","agmatinase (EC 3.5.3.11, reviewed)","arginase (EC 3.5.3.1, reviewed)"]
dat=[df.pct_id_to_query[(df.group==g)&(df.acc!="A0A855A6N2")].values for g in order]
ax[1].boxplot(dat,labels=["APAUH\nEC 3.5.3.24","agmatinase\nEC 3.5.3.11","arginase\nEC 3.5.3.1"],widths=.6)
for k,v in enumerate(dat):
    ax[1].scatter(np.full(len(v),k+1)+np.random.default_rng(k).uniform(-.15,.15,len(v)),v,s=16,color="#2f5d9e",zorder=3,alpha=.8)
ax[1].set_ylabel("% identity to C. leptum CH238_05280")
ax[1].set_title("The two candidate activities overlap completely in identity,\nso putrescine supply in C. leptum stays undecided",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
out.to_csv("speB_family_placement.csv",index=False)
